question: In a certain code language, ‘PENCIL’ is written as ‘NEPLIC’ and ‘ERASER’ is written as ‘ARERES’. How will ‘GEOMETRY’ be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

‘PENCIL’ is written as ‘NEPLIC’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/70d5fe8cf41b35c04e8d998328f7ba49bb4c2d4eb43971a8ef18d05b8afe09b0.png] 

And,

‘ERASER’ is written as ‘ARERES’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6e112ef91799e77958faf7746c016351c5f6e728940341c0acb70cb35ea5f160.png] 

Similarly,

‘GEOMETRY’ is written as

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bcde2301cb224fcfa1ebf980ef3302ab9c75c28d5dae5b19157b9fdf3e46973e.png] 

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
